FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 627
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/18/2026
House Bill 627 as introduced would increased the obligations of the various state departments
and entities, funded by the respective funds that state employees are paid, by an estimated
annual maximum of $560,000, in the aggregate, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by increasing
the state employee non-overnight meal allowance for trips between 6 and 12 hours duration
from 15% of the regular per diem rate ($12.75), under current law, to 17.5% of the regular per
diem rate ($14.88).
The regular per diem rate is currently set by the Governor, pursuant to state law, at $85.
